### PR #3 Overview: `docs(investigations): add google services evaluation and deployment guide`

* **Author:** @nqdd (Dat Nguyen)

* **Changes:** 1 commit, +324 lines across 1 new file: [`docs/investigations/google-services-investigation.md`](file://~/projects/playground/hackathon/google/hackathon-builder-cup-manufacturing-anomaly/docs/investigations/google-services-investigation.md)
* **Status:** Open (Review requested from you)

---

### What Was Added?

The PR adds an architectural, operational, and financial evaluation guide for all **12 Google Cloud services, AI models, and tools** powering the Kaizen Agent platform:

#### 1. Tech Stack & Service Matrix
A structured comparative table detailing official docs, pricing links, purpose, local dev strategy, and production setup for:
* **Google ADK (Agent Development Kit):** Orchestrates multi-agent state machines across the 4 incident phases (Detection, Tracing/RCA, Resolution, Continuous Learning).
* **Gemma 3 Edge:** Lightweight on-prem model for defect pre-classification and edge privacy filtering (drops >95% of normal frames).
* **Gemini 2.0 (Flash/Pro):** Multimodal reasoning for metrology defect inspection, sensor correlation, 5-Whys root cause analysis, and 8D reporting.
* **Gemini Live API:** Real-time bi-directional audio/video streaming for the Technician Copilot headset/mobile assistant.
* **Gemini Video:** Video SOP extraction from expert physical repair recordings.
* **Vertex AI Search / RAG:** Citations and vector retrieval over machine manuals, schematics, and historical 8D reports.
* **Cloud Firestore / In-Memory Blackboard:** Reactive shared incident state bus with SSE streaming.
* **Cloud Pub/Sub:** High-throughput telemetry and event distribution.
* **Google BigQuery:** Enterprise warehouse for traceability graphs, sensor time-series, and sustainability metrics.
* **Cloud Run & Firebase Hosting:** Serverless backend container hosting and frontend dashboard CDN.
* **Manufacturing Data Engine (MDE):** Enterprise MES/SCADA integration roadmap.

#### 2. Deep-Dive Codebase & Agent Mapping
Maps each Google service directly to its module in the codebase:
* [`quality_inspector.py`](file://~/projects/playground/hackathon/google/hackathon-builder-cup-manufacturing-anomaly/backend/agents/quality_inspector.py) (Phase A Detection & Phase C Gatekeeper)
* [`traceability.py`](file://~/projects/playground/hackathon/google/hackathon-builder-cup-manufacturing-anomaly/backend/agents/traceability.py) & [`process_analyst.py`](file://~/projects/playground/hackathon/google/hackathon-builder-cup-manufacturing-anomaly/backend/agents/process_analyst.py) (Phase B Tracing & Telemetry correlation)
* [`root_cause.py`](file://~/projects/playground/hackathon/google/hackathon-builder-cup-manufacturing-anomaly/backend/agents/root_cause.py) & [`rag_search_tool.py`](file://~/projects/playground/hackathon/google/hackathon-builder-cup-manufacturing-anomaly/backend/tools/rag_search_tool.py) (Phase B RCA synthesis)
* [`technician_copilot.py`](file://~/projects/playground/hackathon/google/hackathon-builder-cup-manufacturing-anomaly/backend/agents/technician_copilot.py) (Phase C Resolution via Gemini Live API)
* [`incident_scribe.py`](file://~/projects/playground/hackathon/google/hackathon-builder-cup-manufacturing-anomaly/backend/agents/incident_scribe.py) (Phase C 8D report generation)
* [`continuous_learning.py`](file://~/projects/playground/hackathon/google/hackathon-builder-cup-manufacturing-anomaly/backend/agents/continuous_learning.py) (Phase D Video SOP extraction & sustainability metrics)

#### 3. Local Development & $0 Cloud Emulation Guide
Explicit instructions for local emulation with zero cloud cost:
* **BigQuery:** `goccy/bigquery-emulator` on port 9050 + automatic local mock CSV fallback (respecting Key Invariant 4).
* **Blackboard:** Built-in in-memory reactive asyncio blackboard (no mandatory Docker dependencies) or optional Firestore emulator.
* **Edge Gateway:** Built-in edge simulator or local Ollama (`ollama run gemma:2b`).
* **Gemini APIs:** Free Google AI Studio API key.

#### 4. 12-Factor Zero-Code Cloud Switching
Details the configuration pattern via `mise.local.toml` and environment flags (`BIGQUERY_EMULATOR_HOST`, `GOOGLE_GENAI_USE_VERTEXAI="true"`). Deployments on Cloud Run seamlessly switch to Application Default Credentials (ADC) without code changes.

#### 5. Cost Projections & Unit Economics
* **Hackathon Demo:** **$0.00 / month** (100% within free tiers and emulators).
* **Pilot Line (10,000 parts/day):** **~$30 – $50 / month**.
* **Medium Factory (5 Lines):** **~$120 – $200 / month**.

---

### Review Findings & Recommendations

1. **Alignment with Repo Invariants:**
   * Fully respects the architectural invariants in [`AGENTS.md`](file://~/projects/playground/hackathon/google/hackathon-builder-cup-manufacturing-anomaly/AGENTS.md) (e.g. Blackboard as shared state, BigQuery mock fallback, no direct agent-to-agent calls).
   * Accurate task mapping with [`mise.toml`](file://~/projects/playground/hackathon/google/hackathon-builder-cup-manufacturing-anomaly/mise.toml).

2. **Branching Convention Check:**
   * **Target Branch:** PR #3 is currently opened against `main`.
   * According to [`AGENTS.md`](file://~/projects/playground/hackathon/google/hackathon-builder-cup-manufacturing-anomaly/AGENTS.md#L182-L198) (*Branching Convention*), all features and docs branches should branch off and merge into **`dev`** first (`main` is production-ready and only receives merges from `dev`).
   * **Recommendation:** You may want to request the author retarget the base branch to `dev` before merging.
